record.title: Thousand Islands Bridge pipeline-solidarity blockade and entry-point suspension, February 17, 2020
record.scope: Canadian span of Thousand Islands Bridge and associated cross-border access
record.direction: Both entry points reported closed; northbound I-81 explicitly stopped at Canadian customs’ request.
record.exceptions: Local access to Wellesley Island was reportedly possible; no claim that every bridge-complex segment closed.
record.imposing_authority: Pipeline-opposition protesters; customs and police traffic restrictions
record.enforcement: Physical blockade and official diversion to Ogdensburg.
record.relationship: Distinct crossing/day from R6-AM-004, in the same protest wave.
record.status_observation: Evidence dated in cited sources; no assumption of present status.
record.official_rationale: Protesters opposed the pipeline crossing Wet’suwet’en territory.
record.context: Same solidarity wave as Rainbow Bridge, following day.
record.uncertainty: Approach closure, protest length and port suspension start at different reported times; no precise-hour continuous interval.

historical.duration_note: No supported continuous operational interval for the stated scope. Same-day hours-long restriction; no zero-day numeric duration.
